collection.title: Infant Rockers & Baby Bouncers
collection.body_html:
Infant Rockers & Baby Bouncers

Infant rockers provide a safe, comfortable space for babies to rest, play, and be soothed throughout the day. These essential baby gear items combine gentle rocking motion with supportive seating to help calm fussy babies while giving parents a hands-free moment.

Modern infant rockers feature multiple recline positions, adjustable harness systems, and removable toy bars to engage babies during awake time. Many models include calming vibration settings that mimic the sensations babies experienced in the womb, helping to extend nap times and reduce crying.

Designed with portability in mind, most infant rockers fold flat for easy storage and transport between rooms. Lightweight frames and carrying handles make it simple to keep baby nearby whether you're in the living room, kitchen, or bedroom.

Safety features include secure 3-point or 5-point harness systems, non-slip feet, and sturdy construction that meets current safety standards. Removable, machine-washable seat covers and fabrics make cleanup straightforward after spit-ups and diaper leaks.

Weight limits typically range from birth to 20-25 pounds or until baby can sit up unassisted. Compact designs fit easily in smaller spaces, making infant rockers practical for apartments and homes with limited square footage.

products.title: Ergonomic Baby Bouncer Chair | Portable Infant Rocker Seat
products.body_html:
ERGONOMIC BABY BOUNCER CHAIR FOR NEWBORNS TO TODDLERS

This ergonomic baby bouncer chair provides a secure, comfortable space for infants while giving parents hands-free time. The natural rocking motion responds to your baby's movements without batteries or cords, creating a soothing experience that mimics being held.

KEY FEATURES

Natural Rocking Motion: The chair uses your baby's natural movements to create a gentle, self-powered rocking motion. No batteries or electrical cords required, making it safe and eco-friendly.

Ergonomic Support: Designed to support a newborn's head, neck, and back properly. The ergonomic structure promotes healthy posture and proper spinal alignment during early developmental stages.

Three Adjustable Positions: Switch between play, rest, and sleep positions to match your baby's needs throughout the day. The adjustable design grows with your child from newborn to toddler years.

Portable and Lightweight: At 15 kg, this bouncer moves easily from room to room. Keep your baby close whether you're in the kitchen, living room, or bedroom.

Machine Washable Fabric: The cloth seat removes easily for machine washing at 40°C with mild, bleach-free detergent. Cleanup is simple and hygienic.

SPECIFICATIONS

Materials: Cloth and Metal
Weight: 15 kg
Load Capacity: 3.5-13 kg
Recommended Age: Newborn to 2 years old
Dimensions: Play mode: 58 x 87 x 39 cm | Shipping mode: 11 x 87 x 39 cm
Care: Machine wash in warm water (40°C) with mild, bleach-free detergent
Package Includes: 1 x Baby Rocking Chair

HOW TO USE

1. Select one of three adjustable positions—play, rest, or sleep
2. Place your baby in the chair and secure the harness
3. The chair rocks gently in response to your baby's movements
4. Enjoy hands-free time while keeping your baby safe and comfortable
